modal/help.modalSubtitle: How to install, search, and navigate bibleit
modal/help.secInstallSummary: Install bibleit on your phone or desktop for full-screen offline access.
modal/help.secInstallP1: bibleit is an offline Progressive Web App (PWA). You can install it on your device for standalone, instant launching without an app store:
modal/help.secInstallIosText: Tap the Share button (square with arrow) at the bottom → scroll down and select Add to Home Screen.
modal/help.secInstallAndroidText: Tap the three dots menu (⋮) in the top right → select Install App (or Add to Home Screen).
modal/help.secInstallDesktopText: Click the Install icon on the right side of the address bar → confirm Install.
modal/help.secInstallFooter: Once installed, the Bible text and indexes remain cached locally on your device.
modal/help.secLookupSummary: Fast book, chapter, and verse citations without clunky search forms.
modal/help.secLookupP1: Jump directly to any passage by typing canonical citations:
modal/help.secLookupLi3Text: Typing a prefix like Rom reveals a 1-16 chapter strip to jump directly with 1 tap.
modal/help.secLookupLi4Text: In the Reader tab, tap the book title to open the 66-book selector.
modal/help.secLookupLi5Text: Tap the bookmark icon on any passage or card to save verses locally in the Saved tab.
modal/help.secSearchSummary: Find passages by meaning or exact phrasing with hybrid retrieval.
modal/help.secSearchP1: bibleit uses a hybrid retrieval engine combining two search modes:
modal/help.secSearchLi1Text: Fast lexical search for exact terms and phrases (e.g. armor of God).
modal/help.secSearchLi2Text: Conceptual embeddings find passages by meaning even when words differ (e.g. peace in anxiety).
modal/help.secSearchLi3Text: Both lists merge into a single ranked result stream.
modal/help.secSearchLi4Text: Enable Inspector Mode in Settings to inspect cosine scores, BM25 signals, and retrieval timings.
modal/help.secRagSummary: AI overviews strictly anchored to retrieved verses with exact citations.
modal/help.secRagP1: When search runs, bibleit generates a Grounded Summary anchored strictly to retrieved scripture passages with exact chapter and verse citations.
modal/help.secRagP2: You can toggle AI summaries on or off in Settings, and install the on-device language model for completely offline generation.
modal/help.secAudioSummary: Listen to any passage, search result, or summary with natural speech.
modal/help.secAudioP1: Listen to scripture hands-free with built-in speech narration:
modal/help.secAudioLi1Text: Tap the speaker icon on any passage card, AI summary, or chapter header to begin.
modal/help.secAudioLi2Text: Cycle playback speed between 0.5x, 0.75x, 1x, 1.25x, and 1.5x in the bottom audio bar.
modal/help.secAudioLi3Text: The audio bar follows along and automatically scrolls to the card or verse currently being spoken.
modal/help.secStorageSummary: Zero remote tracking. Your texts and embeddings stay on your device.
modal/help.secStorageP1: All scripture data, indexes, and on-device models run locally via the browser's Origin Private File System (OPFS).
modal/help.secStorageP2: Search queries and readings remain strictly on your device. You can download or clear offline packages anytime in the Settings tab.

settings/view.pageSubtitle: Preferences, reading atmosphere, retrieval inspector, and offline storage.
settings/view.aiOverviewDesc: Generate grounded scripture summaries when searching topics and questions.
settings/view.inspectorDesc: Show search signal badges, cosine scores, BM25 metrics, and latencies.
settings/view.headingsDesc: Display topical section headings above retrieved passages.
settings/view.onDeviceDescReady: Search scripture strictly on this device without contacting backend servers.
settings/view.onDeviceDescDownload: Download the scripture package below to unlock on-device search.
settings/view.storageDesc: Manage local data stored in Origin Private File System (OPFS).
settings/view.storageRestrictedDesc: Your browser disables device storage (common in Private/Incognito windows). Switch to a standard window to download scripture for offline use.
settings/view.pkgTextDesc: All 66 Protestant books, 31,095 verses (WEB translation). Unlocks offline reading & keyword search.
settings/view.pkgAiDesc: Nomic v1.5 int8 quantized vectors for 2,655 passages. Enables offline vector similarity comparison.
settings/view.pkgModelDesc: Nomic v1.5 on-device neural model (Q8 ONNX). Understands query meaning to power offline semantic search.
settings/view.pkgSlmDesc: SmolLM2 360M Instruct on-device language model (Q4 ONNX). Generates grounded scripture summaries completely offline (inference is currently a bit slower).
settings/view.deleteConfirmDesc: Removes downloaded scripture text and AI models from OPFS. You can re-download anytime.
settings/view.languageDesc: Setting your language also switches the Scripture translation (English uses WEB; French uses Louis Segond 1910).
settings/view.telemetryDesc: Share anonymous searches and passage ratings to help refine results. No personal data is collected.
